text:
Leah M.: Quick heads-up: we9re publishing the SDK v4 breaking-change notice this afternoon. It9s mainly about stricter param names and removal of implicit coercions. :mega:
Tom S.: can you summarize the user impact?
Leah M.: sure. Examples: `client.generate(max_tokens=100, temperature=0.7)` stays the same, but calls that relied on passing `truncate=True` (which v3 silently coerced to a string mode) will now raise a validation error in v4. Also some legacy aliases (e.g., `resp_format`) are removed.
Ravi P.: do we have a short migration checklist for SRE/infra teams to run before upgrading?
Leah M.: yes 9ll paste the checklist and pin examples. TL;DR: 1) run compat lint 2) run canary with rw-compat shim 3) plan rollback pins. Full checklist link below.
docs-bot: Breaking change notice + migration checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v4-breaking (includes playbook, shim, CI rules)
Nina L.: can you drop the immediate pin example for teams who need a fast rollback?
Leah M.: Absolutely. Use these in prod until you9re ready to adopt v4.

``` 
# python
# requirements.txt
redwood-sdk==3.14.2

# node
# package.json
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/inference": "3.14.2"
}
```

Tom S.: how long will the compatibility shim be supported?
Leah M.: The shim (rw-compat) is a short-term bridge: supported for 90 days post-v4 GA. We9ll publish an exact sunset date with the GA.
Ravi P.: what about hosted vs private customers? Any differences?
Leah M.: Hosted will accept legacy forms for a limited overlap window; Dedicated/Private deploys must opt into the shim themselves. Ops docs have the admin flags to enable fallbacks.
Nina L.: are there CI helpers to block accidental upgrades?
Leah M.: Yes 9ve added a pre-commit hook and pytest plugin: `pip install redwood-compat-lint` then `redwood-compat-lint --check src/`. The docs include a sample GitHub Actions snippet to fail PRs that use deprecated args.
Tom S.: telemetry to measure impact?
Leah M.: We included an opt-in fingerprint telemetry that reports param-name shapes (no payloads) and a SQL snippet to estimate affected callsites. Details in the playbook.
Ravi P.: who do teams ping for emergency rollback?
Leah M.: Ping me (@leah) or Ravi on #eng-runtime and open an `sdk-compat` issue in infra. We9ll coordinate a temporary gate if needed.
Nina L.: thanks, please post the docs PR and I9ll review the migration page.
Leah M.: Will do. Expect the docs + shim release this evening UTC. :thumbsup:
